newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mosaix downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Thursday downgraded Mosiax Inc, formerly Digital Systems International Inc, to hold in the wake of its recently approved merger with Viewstar Corp.

-- Dain analyst Glenn Powers said near-term confidence level has fallen in recent weeks, partly because of concern that "management attention to the merger may affect both (Mosaix's) dialer (software) business and ViewStar's software business." Powers also expressed concern about possible recent weakness in ViewStar's European business.
-- Powers lowered the fourth quarter earnings estimate for Mosaix to $0.21 from $0.26 and lowered the 1996 estimate to $0.83 from $0.88.
-- Its shares were trading down 3-7/8 Thursday at 11-3/8.
